# Day 16 – Migration Confidence Dashboard

## Objective

Implemented an enterprise-grade migration dashboard to summarize migration quality and readiness.

## Features

- Migration Dashboard module
- Dashboard JSON generation
- Confidence score calculation
- Risk assessment (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH)
- Validation status tracking
- Executive summary logging
- API response enhancement

## Generated Files

- migration-dashboard.json
- migration-report.json
- migration-summary.json
- pull-request.md

## Benefits

- Provides management-level migration visibility
- Quantifies migration quality
- Highlights deployment readiness
- Supports audit and reporting
